name: Half-Ogre
printedArtCredit: Ron Spencer, p. 97 unnamed Half-Ogre barbarian
sourceDistinctions: The playable Half-Ogre uses the Giant type, Large size, 10-ft. reach, +4 natural armor and level adjustment +2.
The playable entry grants no racial Hit Dice. One class level is ECL 3. Provisional encounter CRs are editorial choices.
The Savage Species version in Appendix 3 uses LA +1. The separately indexed 2014 fifth-edition Half-Ogre is a monster.
portraitForm: Bram Reedbar, an original Half-Ogre Fighter
